user.title: Package Tracker
user.description: Track parcels by tracking number with carrier links, expected dates and overdue alerts. No carrier accounts are needed.

data.remind_overdue_daily: Remind about overdue packages every day

data_description.notify_time: When the daily digest of packages due today and overdue is sent.
data_description.notify_entities: Notify entities that receive the digest (links are included in the message).
data_description.notify_services: Legacy notify services such as mobile_app_phone; tapping the notification opens the tracking page.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also show the digest as a notification in Home Assistant.
data_description.remind_overdue_daily: Without this, each overdue package is announced once.
data_description.archive_after_days: 0 keeps arrived packages in the list until archived manually.
data_description.fallback_tracker: Universal tracking site offered for every package, useful for unknown and international numbers.
